name: oak-visual-comparison
description: Judge whether a rebuilt page matches its visual reference: capture both sides as images at the same canonical width, run the windowed rejection statistics, and read the pair with the heatmap and σ-scores directing attention. Use whenever comparing a rebuild against a design export, a reference render, or a prior capture — fidelity reviews, visual regression triage, and owner-reported "looks different" reports.
author: oaknational
